manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: A tossed ball and a ball released from rest at the top are shown side by side. Velocity and acceleration arrows show gravity acting at the top.
assumptions: No air resistance, the same gravity for both balls, up is positive.
manifest.description: Two lanes share one height scale. The tossed ball rises, reaches the top and falls, while the second ball is held by a gate at the top height until the toss reaches it. After release both fall together.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. Use At top to jump to the shared release.
